d:
Diwali celebrations across India were marred by several fire incidents and firecracker-related accidents. From Rajasthan and Delhi to Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra, fires broke out at shops, residential buildings and markets. Two people died in a fire at a firecracker shop in Rajasthan's Pali, while a 10-year-old boy lost his life after a rocket struck him in Delhi. Pune alone reported 63 fire incidents.
